mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_knowledge_base ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM rag_knowledge_base WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM rag_knowledge_base WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM rag_knowledge_base WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_knowledge_base ( name, description, embedding_model_id, milvus_collection, document_count, chunk_count, status, owner_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{embeddingModelId}, #{milvusCollection}, #{documentCount}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, embedding_model_id = #{embeddingModelId}, milvus_collection = #{milvusCollection}, document_count = #{documentCount}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = #{status}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET document_count = document_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET document_count = GREATEST(document_count - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET chunk_count = chunk_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET chunk_count = GREATEST(chunk_count - #{count}, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
